name: Mikado Azusa
source:
A member of the track team and Yuto's childhood friend.
When they were young, they were quite close and frequently went to each other's houses.
However, as Yuto became more shy as he grew up, Azusa, on the other hand, became more active.
After entering school, she joined the track team, where she excelled in the short-distance race.
She has a cheerful and active personality and is sometimes harsh with Yuto, who does not try to exercise at all.
She secretly has a crush on Misa, a senior member of the same track team. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.silkyssakura.jp/saimindatuzyo/series2.html]Official Site[/url]]

[spoiler]Azusa reunited with her childhood friend Yuto, and he decided to use his hypnotic power from an ancient relic to help her reach her potential with various hypnotic suggestions and trainings.

However, as the time passed by, Yuto slowly found himself increasingly captivated by Azusa, and he began to hypnotize her for his own lust.[/spoiler]
